analysis_rows.symptom: Documentation becomes untrustworthy and ignored by readers
analysis_rows.cause: A single broken example or stale screenshot teaches readers to distrust entire documentation site
analysis_rows.evidence: Page states: A single broken example teaches readers to distrust the rest of the site
analysis_rows.fix: Require validation loop before release, attach docs to code review, keep examples near explanations

analysis_rows.symptom: Documentation gets out of date and diverges between internal and external sources
analysis_rows.cause: Internal docs live in one system, code in another, customer guidance in third, creating routine divergence
analysis_rows.evidence: Page documents that splits look clean on org chart but create duplicate maintenance, version drift, long review threads
analysis_rows.fix: Keep single source of truth close to codebase, version in Git, review doc changes with product changes, publish audience-specific views

analysis_rows.symptom: Teams underinvest in documentation maintenance and sync
analysis_rows.cause: Bad documentation rarely appears as single visible failure on budget; lands as small repeated losses that compound
analysis_rows.evidence: Page shows ten minutes here, blocked deploy there, support queue growth adds up to real money
analysis_rows.fix: Treat documentation as validated part of software delivery pipeline, attach to code review workflow, make ownership visible

analysis_rows.symptom: Documentation remains hard to find and retrieve despite polished site
analysis_rows.cause: Structure organized by internal feature ownership is convenient for authors but terrible for readers
analysis_rows.evidence: Users think I need to upload a file securely, not I need the storage service team's section
analysis_rows.fix: Organize from outside in: quickstarts and tasks at surface, API details below, architecture deeper

analysis_rows.symptom: Automation and AI tools spread stale or inaccurate information faster
analysis_rows.cause: AI can hallucinate parameters, miss permission edge cases, describe outdated behavior without human review gate
analysis_rows.evidence: Page notes teams save hours on drafting then lose days cleaning up confident mistakes in public docs
analysis_rows.fix: Use AI for low-trust drafts only, require human review for user-visible claims, keep source traceability, limit publishing rights
